name: jev-monitor
description: Watches the agent's own tool calls (not your typing): flags or blocks edits to its instruction files, writes outside the project, unlisted network targets and other risky shapes. Starts in monitor mode (log and warn only). Reduces risk; does not make an agent safe.

python.title: Python for the server
python.description: Command or path of the Python that has jev-toolkit-monitor installed. Empty: JEV_PYTHON, else `python` (Windows) or `python3` on PATH.
